set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 6. Add checked FmriDataset attachment to AcquisitionContext, adapters from SamplingFrame, VoxelDomain, and current metadata, dataset lowering to ResolvedResponseSelection, and provenance plus receipt propagation. Dataset resolution must stop at decoded response samples; only representation planning may lower into coefficient, atom, transport, or residual coordinates. Acceptance: timing, geometry, mask, ordering, calibration, and schema mismatches are typed failures; no implicit resampling occurs; current DataSelection, indexed queries, and segmentation remain compatible; LatentResponseDatasetBackend shrinks to a thin adapter or disappears.
set.title: RRA 6: attach response sources to datasets with checked alignment
